item.title: MMA Sabah: Only 34% Of Medical Officers Showed Up For Hospital Postings
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MMA Sabah says only 34% of medical officers from outside Sabah posted to hospitals in the state had reported for duty (47 out of 138). If this 66% no-show rate persists till Oct 7, it will exceed the deputy health minister's earlier 50% no-show projection.
